scope: All registered researchers using the single R&D LaTeX control tower; applies to student-facing source and PDF review, irrespective of document genre or whether first-person writing is allowed

separation_of_concerns.human_scientific_authority: researcher, supervisor and relevant university rules

rules.requirement: Write from the student's actual experience and research role; avoid framing the student as an external interview respondent when they are the author. First-person past tense is permitted only when supported by field records and institution/supervisor writing rules. Third person is correct for genuine outside authors/participants.
Never invent sites, participant responses, fieldwork, site diaries, interviews, sample sizes, times, costs, causal diagnoses, academic credentials, consent, approvals, or laboratory tests.

Distinguish photograph, direct observation, suspected defect, documented corrective event, verified physical cause, measured cost and critical-path delay. An image alone does not confirm a cause or rework quantity.

Use descriptive academic figure/table captions, not internal machine control IDs, A9 labels, ChatGPT/QA jargon or case codes. Keep stable photo IDs in private manifests and source graphic paths, not in typeset captions. Never remove legitimate published research identifiers.

Every researcher owns their objectives, admitted populations, cases, photos and conclusions. Scope exclusion is manuscript-specific; Safal's road-case exclusion must not automatically remove valid road research from other projects.

Citations must support their actual claims; removing a research topic requires removing its unneeded discussion/figures and unused bibliography entries without deleting unrelated evidence in the preserved previous version.
Do not misrepresent AI/writing assistance or conceal its use when disclosure is required. Student must review, correct and accept the manuscript content.

Preserve prior source/ref, advance source version and source commit, compile from exact approved candidate plus private deps, record PDF SHA and toolchain, upload to correct Drive folder and read back ID/parent before calling deliverable complete.

Typography/layout belongs in one .sty; semantic integrity in this JSON plus validator; student-specific cover content and spacing variants belong in project configuration. Generalized shared cover-gap helper is opt-in, not a forced 30pt global change.
Static linting, exact-font PDF compilation, whole-page visual QA, science review, full PU formatting acceptance, and A9 Local/Main acknowledgment are separate gates. No one gate implies another.

linter.scan: manuscript frontmatter abstracts, chapters and appendices
guardrails: Flag student-self third-person constructions for review, not automatic replacement
Flag uppercase administrative photo identifiers only where visible text is detectable
No repair or prose rewriting in validation code
False positives reviewed by manuscript owner; never blanket-forbid first/third person

permissions: Never upload private original photographs or licensed font binaries to public repository
institution_override: Applicable PU and supervisor directions on style, authorship and ethics take precedence

lineage.derived_from: RSH-010 v1.11 author-voice correction and v1.12 source/figure/cover-spacing work
